svg.title: Component diagram: the workbench process
svg.desc: The workbench process has nine components. The start script loads the product code, starts the workbench construct and the Vite development server, and attaches the construct manager with the behaviors. The page gets page code from the Vite development server and connects to the hub and to each product construct through it. The Vite development server passes the link to the workbench construct, and the link of each product construct to the product construct. The storage subsystems read, watch, and write the model folder and the product model folder, and send the model to the workbench construct. The construct manager reads the product and the construct list from the workbench construct, and starts, stops, and updates the product constructs. Each product construct runs the behaviors with the update subsystem, which calls the product code. The generator of the view types reads the definitions from the workbench construct.
